ack.title: Please read and confirm
ack.subtitle: {count, plural, one {An announcement requires} other {# announcements require}} your confirmation that you have read it.

role.permissions_changed: {actor} changed the permissions of your role “{role}”.

user.session_limit: {count} earlier session(s) ended: the limit is {limit} sessions.
user.sessions_ended: {actor} ended your open sessions. Sign in again.

delegation.awaiting_holder: {actor} proposes that {delegate} signs “{permission}” on your behalf, from {start} to {end}. It awaits your agreement.

delegation.revoked: {actor} revoked the delegation of “{permission}” from {delegator} to {delegate}.

activity_archive.reminder: Reminder: the activity log of {month} will be deleted automatically on {delete_on}. Download its archive before if you need it.
activity_archive.deleted: The activity log of {month} ({rows} entries) was deleted automatically after its archiving period.

complaint.returned: {actor} returned complaint {number} for more work instead of closing it.

purchase_order.awaiting_approval: Purchase order {number} ({supplier}) awaits your approval. Prepared by {actor}.

ncr.assigned: {actor} made you responsible for non-conformance report {number}: {title}.

ncr.not_effective: {actor} found the actions of report {number} not effective: back to the corrective actions.

ncr_action.assigned: {actor} assigned you a corrective action on report {number}: {action} (due {due}).

rejection.awaiting_decision: Rejection {number} ({quantity} {unit}) awaits your decision. Recorded by {actor}.

return.awaiting_approval: Customer return {number} ({customer}) awaits your approval. Registered by {actor}.
return.awaiting_receipt: {actor} approved customer return {number} ({customer}): expect the goods back.

order.awaiting_release: Production order {number} awaits release. Created by {actor}.
order.awaiting_close: Production order {number} is completed and awaits closing.
